findings.decision: Use exact dimensions and basis per source, shared 6↔1 UI check only for that behavior. HX-BL-058 label scope is already in backlog.

L1 editable/persisted map data and anchored hints may be checked together at the point/field contract; L2 access and discovery triggers are distinct. Crows known place, Knave separately located hint, DND observable sign and SD warning have distinct fixtures.
C/P/V and C/P/H selective generalization stay in L1. Shared physical scale or icon visibility does not prove same data retention.
